moments.author: Dak Prescott
moments.quote: You say that once I look off, huh? … He heard me.
moments.why: A viral hallway exchange where Dak fires back at a heckler labeling the Cowboys’ loss 'embarrassing'—it’s widespread reaction fodder.

moments.author: Stephen A. Smith
moments.quote: Christmas always comes early with these dudes. They never let me down.
moments.why: His gleeful reaction to the Cowboys' collapse amplifies the national narrative around their choke—huge online buzz.

moments.author: Jerry Jones
moments.quote: We’re back to square one with a moribund defense.
moments.why: As both owner and GM, his brutal postgame assessment stung and spread fast among fans and pundits alike.

moments.author: Justin Reid
moments.quote: If I ever did that, then I wouldn’t care! … I am a good player and I make plays…
moments.why: His fiery post-loss X rant defending himself and lashing out at fans ignited backlash and trended hard.
